meta.description: OPTIONAL shadow-only session-bundle receiver (doc 15 §3). Import INACTIVE. Uses a shadow-only header credential, rejects anything not marked shadowMode/simulation-only, drops duplicate idempotency keys via the va_shadow_sessions data table, writes one summary row, responds 200. NO production credentials, NO forwards to the ticketing app, NO sub-workflows, NO retries (bounded retry lives app-side and counts against the shadow budget).
